In Re: Sujal Ali @ nawaz Ali @ Nuwaj Ali  Petitioner  Mr. Sujoy Sarkar  Mr. Arup Sarkar  Ms. Sneha Srivastava  Mr. Rahul Chachar For the Petitioner  Mr. Sujan Chatterjee For the State

entities.text: Sujal Ali @ nawaz Ali @ Nuwaj Ali
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text:
1. 
In spite of service the victim is not represented.

2. The report filed by the S.I as regards service is taken on record,
3. Considering the materials available in the case diary, the nature and extent of complicity of the petitioner in the commission of the alleged offence and having regard to the nature of the statement of the victim, we are of the view that custodial interrogation of the petitioner is not necessary.

4. Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioner, namely, Sujal Ali @ nawaz Ali @
Nuwaj Ali shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/-, with two registered sureties of like amount each, subject to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer and also to comply with the conditions as laid down in Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 corresponding to Section 482(2) of the BNSS, 2023.
